title: Irish Fish Paella
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, this Irish Fish Paella combines fresh Irish cod with zesty flavors.

ingredients.name: Zesty Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lemon juice adds a bright flavor

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Extra virgin olive oil for sautéing

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Crushed tomatoes for a rich sauce

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika for a deep, savory flavor

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.notes: Fresh thyme for added herbal notes

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add the chorizo and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to break down.
Add the paella rice and stir to coat with the oil and mix with the tomato mixture.
Add the fish, paprika, thyme, and salt. Stir to combine.
Add the lemon juice and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme and lemon wedges.
